description: M01-U10 case index: each spec §17 case group (model and local-runtime variants) and each plan §5 / m01-plan §3 M01 exit claim mapped to concrete Cargo test targets and test names. check-case-index.py verifies every name against real run logs. kind: model | integration | e2e | process-crash | in-process | substrate | property. expect: ok (must have run and passed) or gap-ignored (exists, #[ignore]d because the product does not implement the ruling yet; must have run with --ignored and failed). platform_only: {"<target>" | "<target>::<test name prefix>": [platforms]} limits the platforms a test applies to; platform_only_rationale gives the reason for an entry (ADR-0006 §13.12 item 4).

No external side effects needed to verif.note: Every A06/A07/A08/A19/A29/A17-local test above uses testkit::FakeCredentialAdapter (in-memory or a disposable ledger file in a temp dir), VirtualClock/ScriptedTimeSync or the host clock, Store::open_in_memory or a temp-dir database, and owner-only Unix sockets / named pipes in temp dirs; no network, provider or remote host is contacted by any test (the remote hosts only executed the binaries).

N06 exit cases (m01-plan U10 r2.1).note: N06 (a) and (b) run through the production Supervisor cleanup executor with a fake ResourceCleaner (in-process); the substrate-only case and the operations-path reading (no automatic retry of an operation) are indexed under A17-local only, not counted here.
